findings.finding: E2E checked only the first data input; a second input left as wildcard passed.
findings.resolution: Assert every data input and output type. The same injected defect passes the old E2E and fails the revised E2E.

findings.finding: Runtime before-values were the sole round-trip oracle; unchanged wrong setup or serialization could pass.
findings.resolution: Declare widget names/order and non-default values independently; assert them before/after both native loads and in both serialized representations. Control Bridge now uses false/Mute.

findings.finding: The order precondition checked ImpactInt rather than the directly connected Inversed Switch.
findings.resolution: Check the saved position of Inversed Switch against its consumer.

findings.finding: The new E2E depended on a switch-specific fixture despite an existing shared browser fixture.
findings.resolution: Reuse e2e_ui.ui; continue using the existing native export and widget observation helpers.

findings.finding: Four affected handlers captured previous callbacks that they never used.
findings.resolution: Remove four unused bindings; make the unchanged Compare local immutable.

findings.finding: The harness assumed registration order; some cases checked captured slot references without checking the whole output contract.
findings.resolution: Find the named extension and assert actual input/output arrays in all cases, including preservation of the BOOLEAN output.

reinvention_assessment: Node standard test/VM APIs match the existing repository approach; no dependency, generic graph engine, or new shared abstraction is needed. The four one-line fallback expressions stay next to their callbacks.
test_matrix_assessment: Retain 20 fast unit cases and 20 browser cases: five registered node types, two serialization orders, and both restoration modes cover distinct contracts.
validation_adjustment: A preliminary stricter assertion counted frontend widget-backed inputs as data inputs. It was corrected before the final mutation, baseline, and full regression runs; preliminary artifacts remain marked initial.
